authentication.tenant: One organization/workspace per installation. Scopes cover the whole workspace, not individual portal customers. Portal backend enforces its end-user ownership. Never expose this token to browsers.
authentication.billing_boundary: Dedicated server identity only. Verify Stripe webhook signatures, then read canonical Checkout/invoice/payment/refund/subscription objects with the operator-configured provider account. Never forward browser assertions, raw event bodies or secrets. This endpoint records evidence; it cannot execute charges or refunds.

write_rules.replay: Same actor, method/path semantics and JSON body plus original key return the stored response. Reusing the key for another payload returns 409. Retain pending body/key durably in portal/worker outbox.
write_rules.versions: Every transition requires the version returned by GET. After 409 reload and reassess; do not replace the version blindly.
write_rules.external_ids: source + resource kind + external_id unique. Duplicate creation with a new key returns 409 identifying the existing record. GET lookup resolves lost responses.
write_rules.atomicity: Business records, immutable quote/contract snapshots, events and command receipt commit in one SQLite transaction. Offer acceptance creates exactly one core order and one contract.
write_rules.dates: YYYY-MM-DD; EUR integer cents; taxes from published operator catalog. Automatic tax jurisdiction determination is not implemented.

endpoints.returns: Current immutable revision, state version, items; version 0 and no items before explicit operator publication.

endpoints.notes: version=0 initially. Revision IDs immutable. hosting/saas have once/monthly/yearly charges and bounded integer dimensions. website/webapp/service remain manual unless operator opts in with auto_quote:true. Priced items may use charges:[] with priced dimensions. Nonempty positive selected total required; no frontend prices or custom dimension keys. No production prices seeded.
Binds source/external_id to an actual core customer. Customer corrections use the existing versioned CRM endpoint by an authorized operator.
version and customer_version plus customer:CustomerInput. Both optimistic versions required; concurrent core operator edits yield 409. Issued document snapshots remain immutable.

source, external_id, external_customer_id, catalog_revision, configuration_revision, item_id, quantity, configuration. No client prices. Requires current catalog. configuration_revision is an immutable caller reference, not a trusted price. Complete company and customer address required for priced offer.
Individual projects: attach an issued core quote for same customer, checking quote_version. Project lines are one-time. Projects cannot be accepted before this step.
version + acceptance_reference. Expiry and current quote state checked. Returns order, contract_id, billing_plan and pending provisioning. No charge/provider action occurs.

version, status, external_reference, error_code. pending->running/failed; running->ready/failed; failed->running. ready requires reference; failed requires error. This records the authenticated worker report, not independent infrastructure proof.
Legacy finance operator initial invoice. Exactly one initial invoice from accepted quote; new automated recurring/provider evidence goes through /billing with commerce:billing.

Authoritative current record. Customers include customer and customer_version; orders include payment (initial invoice), billing subscription snapshot and billing.invoices (all cycles). Invoice and order versions independent. paid_cents reflects allocated funds net of scoped refunds; credited_cents/refunded_cents expose corrections.
Recover by external references. Order inherits offer source and external_id.

Durable ascending seq, next_cursor, has_more; 1–200 entries. Persist consumer cursor only after successful processing. Re-fetch referenced object; events are notifications, not executable instructions.

Tagged operation bind, invoice, refund, subscription. Every request includes order version, provider=stripe, provider_account_id, provider_event_id and normal Idempotency-Key. Returns order with billing projection. Rejects amounts/periods inconsistent with accepted server catalog. No raw provider payload, client prices, paid booleans or credentials.

events.invoice_note: commerce.invoice.changed carries invoice ID/version when allocation, refund or cancellation changes linked invoice; resolve existing order invoice reference and GET order. Creation uses order.invoiced.

initial_release_limits: No autonomous invoice scheduler or provider webhook listener in Brilliantis: the dedicated server adapter supplies verified provider invoice-cycle evidence. No upgrades/proration/discounts/trial billing or automatic external provisioning.
No automatic tax-jurisdiction rules; catalog rates require operator setup.
No customer-level authorization within service-token workspace scopes.
No direct purchases, payment execution or infrastructure provisioning. Real provider activation belongs to a separately configured operator workflow.
Tax reporting, statutory annual accounts, DATEV EXTF, ELSTER receipts and e-invoice format validation remain explicit integration gaps. Exports are not submissions.

billing.readiness: GET /readyz exposes commerce_billing_version:1, commerce_payment_capture_version:1 and schema:9. Require the capture capability before payment-only reconciliation.
billing.bind: customer_id (core), provider_customer_id, provider_subscription_id (empty for once only), checkout_reference, started_on YYYY-MM-DD. Immutable one checkout/order and one subscription/order. Bind after canonical Checkout retrieval, before invoice evidence.
billing.invoice: provider_invoice_id (in_ or cs_ once-only fallback), provider_customer_id, provider_subscription_id, initial:boolean, periods:[{cadence:monthly|yearly,start,end}], issue_date, due_date, status:open|paid|payment_failed|void, currency:EUR, total_cents, paid_cents, payments:[{id,amount_cents,booking_date}]. Positive payment entries must sum to paid_cents; paid requires full original gross. Cumulative original payments exclude refunds, which are separate evidence. status:void additionally requires voided_on (actual provider void date) for the correction journal; omitted for all other statuses.
billing.periods: Initial contains once and every selected recurring cadence. Later invoices contain only the supplied recurring cadences, with whole periods anchored to started_on; month/year anniversaries clip to the last day and preserve the original anchor. No prorations, discounts, trials or quantity changes in billing evidence. Recurring invoices may arrive before initial; periods and initial invoices are each unique.
billing.payment: Once-only captured Checkout without a provider invoice: provider_payment_id (real pi_...), provider_charge_id (real ch_...), provider_customer_id, checkout_reference, issue_date, booking_date, currency:EUR, amount_cents. Requires an existing matching once-only binding and the exact full stored order amount. The adapter must verify the canonical succeeded PaymentIntent and paid/captured Charge. Creates/issues the original Brilliantis invoice and allocates the real payment; no fake provider_invoice_id. Immutable payment_capture on the order retains the evidence and core invoice ID; billing.invoices exposes provider_payment_id/provider_charge_id instead of provider_invoice_id. Repeated identical captures remain no-ops for accounting even after partial/full refunds. Payment and Charge references cannot be assigned to another order. Existing invoice and new capture modes cannot be mixed for one initial invoice.
billing.refund: provider_invoice_id (omit only for payment-only captures), provider_customer_id, provider_subscription_id, provider_refund_id, payment_id, amount_cents, currency:EUR, booking_date. Without a provider invoice, payment_id is the captured pi_... and provider_subscription_id is empty. Successful canonical provider refund only. Requires imported payment. Partial corrections split original VAT groups with cumulative rounding; each refund has a credit note and negative PSP transaction allocated in the immutable journal. Final full refund exactly reverses the original gross/net/tax/rounding. No new payment is inferred.
billing.subscription: provider_customer_id, provider_subscription_id, status:active|past_due|unpaid|paused|canceled|incomplete|incomplete_expired|trialing, cancel_at_period_end:boolean, observed_at:Unix seconds of authoritative observation. Old observations cannot reactivate cancellation. This records provider state; the website service performs provider cancellation separately. Historical invoices may still be reconciled after cancellation; new future periods are rejected.
billing.replay: HTTP key+body+actor replay remains strict. Provider event uniqueness is provider/account/event/operation, with order and immutable evidence fingerprint. Event replay may use a new HTTP key/version. Same event can bind, invoice and update subscription using distinct HTTP keys. New events cannot reuse an invoice/payment/refund ID inconsistently or invoice overlapping periods. 409 stale order version: GET and reassess, preserve evidence. Missing binding/payment is retryable after reconciliation.
billing.operator_catalog: publish-commerce-catalog --database PATH --input-file PATH --expected-version N validates the same CommerceCatalog, requires an existing workspace/current schema/matching profile, atomically publishes as operator.cli and replays an already identical current revision. No admin service token needed.

gross_pricing.input: Charge and LineInput optionally accept unit_gross_cents (EUR integer cents, 0..100000000000). unit_price_cents remains required net cents and must equal floor((unit_gross_cents * 10000 + (10000 + tax_basis_points)/2) / (10000 + tax_basis_points)). The existing quantity, tax-rate and document limits still apply. Omit unit_gross_cents for the unchanged net-pricing mode.
gross_pricing.calculation: Net line amounts and VAT rate-group rounding remain unchanged. A gross-priced line has gross_cents = round(quantity_milli * unit_gross_cents / 1000) and rounding_cents = gross_cents - net_cents - tax_cents. No caller-supplied rounding_cents is accepted. Aggregate quote, core order, contract and invoice snapshots store the sum of line rounding_cents; their gross_cents is the agreed payable amount, net_cents + tax_cents + rounding_cents.
gross_pricing.renewals: Immutable billing_plan lines retain unit_gross_cents. Each invoice selects its due cadences and recalculates VAT and rounding from those stored lines. Thus gross recurring prices remain fixed independently of one-off lines. Payment and billing.invoices summaries expose rounding_cents when the source invoice contains it.
gross_pricing.accounting: Payable rounding is journaled separately to revenue:rounding or expense:rounding without changing VAT or inventing a tax-free position. Partial refunds proportionally allocate the taxable consideration and signed rounding cumulatively; complete refunds reverse every original net, tax and rounding cent.
gross_pricing.exports: UBL TaxInclusiveAmount and CII GrandTotalAmount remain net plus VAT. PayableRoundingAmount (UBL) or RoundingAmount (CII) bridges to PayableAmount / DuePayableAmount. Print and workspace views show non-zero rounding separately. These remain draft XML artifacts pending the existing schema/Schematron gate.
gross_pricing.compatibility: No migration or repricing of existing records. Missing gross fields retain legacy net calculation and response shape. Catalog revisions and accepted snapshots remain immutable; publish a new revision for gross prices.
